name: Drakes

variantInfo.name: Drake
notes: Wingless draconic Slayer monster found on the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon.
Uses Ranged, ranged melee, and a volcanic breath dragonfire attack that deals 6-8 damage for four hits if not avoided or protected against.
After seven auto-attacks it launches volcanic breath at the player's current tile.
Vulnerable to dragonbane weapons including dragon hunter lance, dragon hunter crossbow, and dragon hunter wand.
Takes 50% more damage from water spells.
Drake's claw and Drake's tooth are five times more common while killed on a Slayer task.

variantInfo.name: Guardian Drake
notes: Superior slayer monster unlocked by purchasing Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points.
Uses the regular Drake volcanic breath special when the player is not in melee distance.
Also has a special melee attack in melee distance that stuns and can hit over 30 damage through prayer.
The melee special can be predicted when yellow gaps on its back light up and avoided by stepping out of melee distance quickly.
Guardian Drakes have a 50% water spell weakness.

locationComparison.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
notes: Drakes are found on the middle level of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon in Mount Karuulm.
The task page recommends the task-only area because the smaller room lets a cannon make better use of its shots.
Boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots are required before Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary protection.
The dungeon is accessible from Mount Karuulm teleports, fairy ring CIR, Battlefront Teleport, Skills necklace, or Farming cape routes.

taskNotes: Drakes require 84 Slayer and 90 combat to be assigned.
They are found in the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon and require access to Mount Karuulm.
Before completing the Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary, wear boots of stone, boots of brimstone, or granite boots to avoid constant heat damage from the floor.
Drakes are draconic, so dragonbane weapons are very effective.
Drakes take 50% more damage from water spells.
Protect from Missiles fully blocks normal ranged attacks.
After seven auto-attacks, Drakes launch volcanic breath at the player's current position.
Volcanic breath deals 6-8 damage per hit for four hits without dragonfire protection, but can be reduced or negated with dragonfire protection or avoided by moving one tile.
Together, Protect from Missiles and dragonfire protection can let the player take no damage when attacking from at least one tile away.
Drake's claw and Drake's tooth upgrade boots of stone and holy sandals, and these drops are five times more common on a Slayer task.
Guardian Drakes can appear if superior monsters are enabled; their melee special can stun and hit heavily if the player does not move out of melee distance.
Most players tend to block drakes because they have high assignment weight, lacklustre drops, high stats, and flat armour despite being cannonable.
recommendedMethod: Use dragonbane melee or ranged with Protect from Missiles and dragonfire protection. Cannon the task-only Karuulm room, wear heat-protection boots unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete, and move one tile to dodge volcanic breath when not fully protected.
